interpretation: Observed, family-adjusted and genus-adjusted V2 stages are compared on the same frozen decomposition support and information weights. Stage-specific sample loss is therefore not a viable explanation for the existing attenuation within the V2 decomposition.
claim_boundary: P1a does not show that true genus boundaries outperform arbitrary partitions of matched complexity, does not provide paired uncertainty for attenuation, and does not identify a causal assembly mechanism. Those remain P1c/P1d questions.
